assign.outcome: **Reproduced and fixed the ext/catalog unreachable-content bug (18/205 pages) and its own regression before landing.** Bound chosen: a real height CEILING derived from the flex/grid chain (mirroring .fill/.page.topic's definite-height trick — align-self:stretch + grid-template-rows:1fr on the catalog .page, align-items:stretch on .page-catalog), not a calc(100dvh-guess) which breaks the moment the nav wraps at 390px. Fix lives entirely in catalog.css; /styles.css was correct as-is and untouched. Verified all 18 named pages (web/nav/* + web/layout/*) plus 7 spot-checked pages from every other catalog() family, at 390/1280/3440: zero clipped, LayoutTool high-severity eliminated (82-86/B, matching the 7→77/8→82 figures cited in the brief). Caught and fixed a self-inflicted regression before landing: the first pass's unscoped overflow-y:auto collapsed every Doc Overview tab (core/App, core/Page, ext/ui, 8 pages) to clientHeight:0 — worse than the original bug — because a Doc Overview sits in a .tab-panel with no definite height anywhere above it, and CSS gives an overflow!=visible flex item an automatic min-size of 0. Fixed by scoping the new declarations to `.pages > .page:has(> .page-catalog) > .page-catalog > .page-catalog-pages` so only a catalog thats a direct child of an actual .pages region gets the new behavior. One pre-existing, out-of-scope finding recorded not fixed: /framework/core/Page/ (a Doc Overview) has a 73-85px rail overshoot at 1280/3440, documented in decisions.md as a known trap predating this task, unrelated to the fix (its own outer scroll works fine, so nothing is unreachable). Recorded in ext/catalog/readme.md Traps + doc/decisions.md.
